Top-level `id` wins; every existing parser tries `id` first and only falls back to `identity.node_id` (snapshot.py:131-136, checks.py:89-93, self_reflection.py:338-341). Keep that precedence.

Already resolved: id is `id` or `identity.node_id`; if neither resolves it is a missing required key -> GraphSnapshotReadError. A str `identity` with `id` present is valid (fixture does it: tests/fixtures/knowledge_graph/static_desk_source_graph.json:5-9).

Existing parsers treat null/falsy as absent: role falls back to 'related' (checks.py:117,129; snapshot.py:154) and other edge metadata is kept only when `str` (checks.py:135-139). Match it: explicit null -> default.
Existing parsers build lists and preserve JSON array order (snapshot.py:149-155; checks.py:96-99; self_reflection.py:357-364). Use lists, keep input order.
Signature already says `path: Path`; all call sites pass Path (checks.py:32,40; cli/main.py:321-326). str/PathLike support is not required.

Task enumerates only missing file/invalid JSON/missing key. Current code raises on not-exists/not-file (checks.py:41-42) but lets other OSErrors (PermissionError, IsADirectoryError, UnicodeDecodeError) escape. Fix: catch OSError and wrap in GraphSnapshotReadError.

GraphSnapshotReadError is a fieldless RuntimeError subclass (snapshot.py:29), raised with f-string messages (snapshot.py:53,58). The CLI only formats it as text: print(f"Error: {exc}") (cli/main.py:293,330). No attribute contract needed.

GraphMissingCheckError is also a fieldless RuntimeError subclass (checks.py:13), raised with an f-string (checks.py:42). No constructor/payload to conflict; subclassing GraphSnapshotReadError keeps cli/main.py:292,329 catch sites working.

Current `read_graph_neighbors(snapshot_path: Path, node_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]` lives in snapshot.py:50-65 and returns keys node/incoming/outgoing/nodes; the CLI reads those keys (cli/main.py:339-341). Keep the signature and dict shape.

checks.py reads exactly provenance_path/provenance_locator/extractor, from the edge and its `metadata` (checks.py:117,129,135-139); self_reflection.py reads only source/target/role (357-364). Names already match the new Edge fields.
